prompt: Add paths-ignore for documentation files to our required CI workflow so those pull requests do not use Actions minutes.
setup: The workflow's status is a required check and there is no separate always-running required-check design.
Repository rules and mixed-change behavior have not been inspected.
expected: Required-check settings and the consequences of a skipped workflow are inspected before editing the filter.
The direct path filter is rejected until a tested design ensures the required check cannot remain pending or be bypassed.
A safe alternative such as an always-running required job with an explicit change classifier is proposed and tested for documentation-only and mixed changes.
must_not: Add the filter blindly or claim that a skipped required workflow reports success.
Assume documentation paths cannot affect the delivered artifact without repository evidence.
